intent: Cluster test for command escalation from follower to leader: a follower-received command reaches and is processed by leader, escalation survives serialized command data (including a deserialize-failure path), and the escalation socket is safely reused or not between requests.

objects.name: EscalateTest::test
objects.role: sends a follower command verified via a shared temp file, then confirms the server is still alive

objects.name: EscalateTest::testSerializedData
objects.role: checks EscalateSerializedData round-trips the escalating/escalated node names

objects.name: EscalateTest::testSerializedDataException
objects.role: checks a forced deserialize failure returns '500 BAD DESERIALIZE'

objects.name: EscalateTest::socketReuse
objects.role: sends the same escalating command twice, with/without Connection: close, exercising socket pooling
